input.label: CONTRADICTED

contradicting_evidence.quote: our investments in Reality Labs reduced our 2025 overall operating profit by approximately $19.19 billion
Our ability to support these investments is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business.
some of our investments, particularly our investments in our artificial intelligence initiatives as well as Reality Labs, have the effect of reducing our operating margin and profitability

input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Reality Labs losses "do not threaten the company's overall profitability." However, the evidence directly contradicts this interpretation. While Meta remained profitable overall in 2025 (with $83.276 billion in total operating income per E4), the filing explicitly states that Reality Labs investments "have the effect of reducing our operating margin and profitability" (E5) and that "Our ability to support these investments is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business" (E1). The fact that the company's ability to sustain these losses is explicitly described as dependent on other business segments generating sufficient profits indicates that the losses do pose a threat to overall profitability - the threat is currently being mitigated by strong performance elsewhere, but the dependency relationship itself demonstrates the threat exists. The filing language characterizes this as an ongoing risk rather than a non-threatening situation.
